title.en: On the board: units of concentration

say.en: A solution is a solute spread evenly through a solvent. To use it we must say how much solute is present.
Molarity counts moles per litre of solution; molality counts moles per kilogram of solvent.
Mole fraction, mass percent and ppm are the other common ways. Mole fraction has no unit.
Let us work one: 5.85 grams of NaCl made up to 500 millilitres.
Volume changes with temperature, so molarity changes. Molality uses mass, so it does not.
On the board: units of concentration.

narration.en: Dissolve a solute in water. Molality = moles of solute per kg of solvent, mole fraction = moles of solute ÷ total moles, mass % = mass of solute ÷ mass of solution × 100. In the box, each dot is a molecule: orange solute among blue water.
narration.kn: ನೀರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಕರಗಿಸಿ. ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ = ಪ್ರತಿ kg ದ್ರಾವಕಕ್ಕೆ ದ್ರಾವ್ಯದ ಮೋಲ್; ಮೋಲ್ ಭಾಗ = ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ಮೋಲ್ ÷ ಒಟ್ಟು ಮೋಲ್; ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ % = ದ್ರಾವ್ಯ ÷ ದ್ರಾವಣ × 100.

tagline.en: Mass percentage, ppm, mole fraction, molarity and molality, with conversions and temperature dependence.

say.en: Mass %, ppm, x and m are temperature-independent; M is not.
M = mol per L of solution; m = mol per kg of solvent.
Mole fractions of all components add to 1.
Use density to convert between M and m.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. 4 g NaOH is dissolved to make 250 mL of solution. Find the molarity.

say.en: Let us solve this together. 4 grams NaOH is dissolved to make 250 millilitres of solution. Find the molarity.
n equals 4 over 40 equals 0.1 moles.
V equals 0.250 L.
M equals 0.1 over 0.25 equals 0.4 M.
So the answer is 0.4 M.

narration.en: Recap. Molarity uses litres of solution; molality uses kg of solvent. Molality and mole fraction do not depend on temperature. x_A + x_B = 1.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಮೋಲಾರಿಟಿ: ಲೀಟರ್ ದ್ರಾವಣ; ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ: ಕಿ.ಗ್ರಾಂ ದ್ರಾವಕ. ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ ತಾಪಮಾನವನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. x_A + x_B = 1.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Molarity uses litres of solution; molality uses kg of solvent.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಮೋಲಾರಿಟಿ: ಲೀಟರ್ ದ್ರಾವಣ; ಮೋಲಾಲಿಟಿ: ಕಿ.ಗ್ರಾಂ ದ್ರಾವಕ.

say.en: Molality and mole fraction do not depend on temperature.
x A plus x B equals 1.
